description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of three different large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the parameter M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from 20.0 to 40.0. The green line, representing LLaMA1-7B, begins at a perplexity of approximately 28.5 at M=3, dips slightly to around 27.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 27.0 until M=6, then rises to about 36.0 at M=8. The orange line, representing LLaMA1-13B, starts at approximately 20.0 at M=3, decreases slightly to about 19.0 at M=4, and then remains nearly constant around 19.0 until M=7, before rising to about 20.0 at M=8. The blue line, representing Vicuna-7B, begins at approximately 40.0 at M=3, decreases to about 37.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 37.0 until M=7, then rises to about 40.0 at M=8. All lines are marked with their respective colored triangles or stars and are solid lines.
